verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own llms.txt says the commercial Server Pro tier includes a management API, so a first-party programmatic interface exists. The pack shows nothing about its endpoints, auth, scope or reference docs, and the OSS edition has no API evidenced. missing for 10: published API reference documentation, evidence of what the API can drive (sessions, devices, users), availability outside the paid Pro tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent/programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
